Always handy, isn’t it, when the title of a book is a giveaway? And that’s the case here. According to Frédéric Martel, a French writer, lapsed Catholic and gay activist, the Catholic Church is “a system built ... on the homosexual double life and on the most dizzying homophobia… Without this key for understanding, the recent history of the Vatican and the Roman Church remains opaque.”

One was a reference to “loving friendship”, the other to the Nativity of John the Baptist, “whom we know to have been painted as effeminate by both Caravaggio and Leonardo da Vinci”. Look, if having a thing about John the Baptist makes you gay, the homosexuals can move over in that closet, because I’m in there too.
